findings.claim: Generic and smooth trace definitions coincide on the overlap.
findings.check: Put q=1-zeta_p. Generic diagram yields Psi_gen=q^(-n) Sch^(-1); smooth formula cancels factors and yields Psi_sm=Sch^(-1). For p=2, C=completed Q2 algebraic closure, X=Spf OC<T,T^-1>, d=n=1, a generator maps to omega versus omega/2.
assumptions_verified: complete algebraically closed rank-one mixed-characteristic C
affine separated qcqs flat tft smooth admissible formal model
findings.counterevidence: Remark 3.4.15 and Lemma 3.5.4 explicitly intend Sch inverse; smooth formula supports a local correction.

repair.statement: Replace the left vertical multiplication by identity in (3.7), or scale the lower inverse map by the same q^n.
repair.verified: Restores exact smooth/generic overlap, hence the stated Hartogs gluing and inverse-Sch identity.

findings.impact: Theorem 3.5.2 -> integral/mod-p Faltings trace -> Section 4 local duality -> Section 5 global duality. No counterexample to corrected principal theorem.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: The actual generic diagram (3.7) has identical E_C left objects and the upward map times (1-zeta_p)^n; direct TeX and original page 43 agree. The smooth diagram and its explicit formula use the submodule inclusion and cancel the scalar. Theorem 3.5.2 explicitly requires both restrictions to coincide.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: For p=2 and the smooth formal one-dimensional torus over completed Q2-bar, flatness, admissibility, separated qcqs, reduced special fiber and smooth generic fiber all hold. The two formulas send the same section to omega and omega/2. Properness of the eventual global theorem is not a condition of this local existence assertion. Almostification cannot kill the difference: sqrt(2) does not annihilate (OC/2).
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: Remark 3.4.15, the smooth formula and Lemma 3.5.4 identify the intended inverse-Scholze map. Replacing the generic left arrow by identity restores exactly the overlap/Hartogs gluing step, without certifying the entire later duality proof.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: The locally incompatible requirements define the trace subsequently used by integral/mod-p local and global duality. This supports Major for an invalid core construction, independently of the short scalar repair. No counterexample to corrected duality or the journal text is claimed.

location.source: After (4.6), Lemma 4.2.15; counterevidence Warning 4.2.22 and Prop 4.3.6

findings.claim: Multiplication V_chi tensor V_chi' -> V_chi+chi' is always an OC-isomorphism.
findings.check: p=2, R+=OC<t0,t1>/(t0t1-2), l=n1=d=1,m=0. T={(u,u^-1)}; V_chi=OC*t0,V_-chi=OC*t1,V0=OC. Product image 2OC, cokernel OC/2 nonzero and not almost zero.
assumptions_verified: Smooth generic fiber; reduced crossing special fiber
findings.counterevidence: Later unit case is valid; nonunit derived duality uses algebraic reduction, not this false isomorphism. Individual weight lines differ from R_chibar modules.

repair.statement: Multiplication is scalar product_i(varpi_i^min_j(a_ij+b_ij)) times the normalized generator; iso iff scalar is a unit.
repair.verified: Direct defining-relation proof; 49 finite normal-form pairs additionally checked.

findings.impact: No demonstrated core dependency on false nonunit generality; additive decomposition and derived R_chibar duality not disproved.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: The source after (4.6) and Lemma 4.2.15 explicitly assert the multiplication isomorphism for every character and every m>=0; original page 54 was viewed.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: The allowed nonunit standard model OC<t0,t1>/(t0t1-2), m=0, has V_chi=OC t0 and V_-chi=OC t1. The product is 2 OC inside V_0=OC; OC/2 is nonzero and not almost zero. Its special fiber is reduced and its generic fiber smooth.
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: Normalizing monomial exponents subtracts the block minimum and contributes the nonzero scalar product(varpi_i^min_j(a_ij+b_ij)); this gives the stated corrected image and unit criterion. Directly read the two cases in Proposition 4.3.6: the weight-line isomorphism is used only for a unit parameter, while the nonunit case uses algebraic reduction.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: The broader multiplication assertion is false, but the inspected nonunit derived-duality route does not rely on it. Retain Minor and do not confuse V_chi lines with the R_chibar modules.
